description: Garage hub cell (goal.md AD-2): lowrider garage opening onto the street at dusk. Marble text prompt (+ key art once approved) → spz 100k/500k/full + collider + pano + cell.json.

inputs.text: Interior of a lowrider garage on a Bay Area side street at dusk, seen from the middle of the shop floor. The big roll-up door is fully open onto the sidewalk and the street beyond: sodium streetlights just switching on, a strip of golden-hour sky fading into blue hour, fog drifting past telephone wires and a distant hill. Inside: stained concrete floor, an empty hydraulic lift bay in the center, red tool chests, tire racks, chrome rims and candy-flake body panels on shelves, a pegboard wall of tools, one large blank billboard-style wall, a rack of jackets, a workbench with a radio and a coffee pot, warm tungsten work lights against the cool blue dusk outside. Photorealistic, physically plausible light, wistful melancholy-beautiful West Coast mood. No people, no cars.
